mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior three months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of the months when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a monetary policy tightening cycle that increases real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of the cases when the interaction term is above its 90th percentile, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high consumer credit growth (RSAFS), the S&P 500 tends to underperform as the economy approaches a peak, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the periods when RSAFS is above its 80th percentile, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates strengthening supply conditions that boost corporate profits and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods when INDPRO has increased over the prior three months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,200,000 units in a month, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of the months when HOUST falls below 1,200,000 units, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising employment growth (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of the cases when the interaction term is above its 90th percentile, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 105.0), the supply chain is robust and corporate margins expand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of the periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
